Delhi HC appoints Sole Arbitrator in family business dispute — clarifies "reasonable time" test under Section 11(6)
In Sugat Jain v. Amit Jain & Anr. (21.08.2026), the Delhi High Court (Justice Om Prakash Shukla) appointed Justice (Retd.) Ravindra Bhatt as Sole Arbitrator to resolve a family partnership dispute over Aero Enterprises and a collateral security arrangement with PNB.
Key takeaway: Unlike Sections 11(4)/11(5), Section 11(6) prescribes no fixed 30-day period. The Court held that "reasonable time" isn't a mechanical day-count — it must be assessed against the full backdrop of prior mediation, negotiations, and conduct between the parties. Since mediation had already failed and the parties couldn't agree on an arbitrator despite genuine attempts, the petition wasn't premature even though filed soon after the Section 21 notice.
The connected Section 9 petition (interim reliefs re: the security arrangement) was converted into a Section 17 application before the newly constituted Tribunal.
